notes: The round date/amount (2021-10-27, USD 3.7M) is vendor-only; the company's own ad calls it 'seed-stage' but names no round, hence low confidence. Crunchbase (via search) lists Visionaries partners Marton Sarkadi Nagy and Robert Lacher as the seed investors by name; the job advert names the firm, so this is read as a fund position, but the judge should weigh the partner-angel possibility. The UK company is a one-share opco held by the founder, so the investment sits in another (probably US) holding entity; no Form D found under Loxo or Pallery. pallery.com (live) names LocalGlobe as a backer, not Visionaries. Removed from the Visionaries list after 2024.
